scope: Conservative installed runtime dependency closure (dependencies, installed optional dependencies and installed peers) of the Quest, companion, sim, server and shared protocol/control packages, plus the browser-imported emulator packages; supplemental icon attribution and vendored asset notices. This is not a list of modules proven present in every browser bundle, nor all development tools in package-lock.json.

supplementalPackages.name: lucide-react
supplementalPackages.reason: Installed Lucide icon-set ISC notice, supplementing the implementation notices shipped by @pmndrs/uikit-lucide. This entry does not claim React is used by the Quest UI.

vendoredNotices.name: @webxr-input-profiles/assets vendored meshes
vendoredNotices.versionNote: The exact upstream asset package version was not recorded with these vendored files.
vendoredNotices.reason: Existing full MIT notice accompanying generic-hand and meta-quest-touch-plus GLB assets.

vendoredNotices.name: JetBrains Mono vendored regular font
vendoredNotices.versionNote: Vendored font, not an installed npm package; no package version is inferred.
vendoredNotices.reason: Existing full SIL Open Font License accompanying JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf.

vendoredNotices.name: Inter vendored fonts, CE Inter Tabular and generated MSDF atlas
vendoredNotices.versionNote: Vendored/derived assets; provenance and reproduction are documented in apps/quest/public/fonts/README.txt.
vendoredNotices.reason: Preserves the exact existing notice accompanying the copied and derived Inter assets, independently of the installed font package version.
